logs_snippet: ERROR: Thread pool exhausted. Queue size: 512. Rejecting request after 30s wait.
resolution: Scaled deployment from 3 to 6 replicas. Increased thread pool maxThreads=200. Root cause: upstream traffic spike from marketing campaign.

logs_snippet: WARN: GC overhead limit exceeded. java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space at java.util.HashMap.resize
resolution: Identified unbounded session cache HashMap. Replaced with Caffeine LRU cache (maxSize=10000, TTL=30min). Added heap alert at 80%. Pod restarted.

logs_snippet: ERROR: HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms. Active:25 Idle:0 Max:25
resolution: Killed 45 idle DB connections. Increased HikariCP pool from 10 to 25. Added 30s connection timeout. Added pool_pre_ping=True. Deployed hotfix.

logs_snippet: torch.cuda.OutOfMemoryError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 2.50 GiB. Allocated: 7.8GiB / 8.0GiB on ml-inference device=cuda:0
resolution: Batch size not adjusted after GPU instance downgrade A100 (40GB) to T4 (16GB). Fixed: dynamic batch sizing using torch.cuda.get_device_properties(). Set batch_size=32 (was 128). Restarted service. Canary deployment enforced for future model updates.

logs_snippet: WARNING data-pipeline - Kafka consumer lag at 8240 messages (threshold: 5000). Topic: product-events, Group: ml-pipeline
resolution: Single-threaded consumer could not keep up with product event burst after catalog import (8000 events/min). Fixed: consumer threads scaled 1 to 8. Added lag alerting at 5000 message threshold. Set partition assignment to cooperative-sticky strategy.

logs_snippet: ERROR celery-worker - redis.exceptions.ConnectionError: Error 111 connecting to localhost:6379. Connection refused. Task failed after 3 retries.
resolution: Redis container ran out of memory and was OOM-killed by the OS. Increased Redis maxmemory to 2GB, set maxmemory-policy=allkeys-lru. Added Redis memory monitoring. Added health check to celery worker startup.
